title: The Loyalty Concession the Desk Allows a Frequent Package Traveller
content:
The vacation packages desk allows a loyalty concession of 2 per cent to a traveller whose record of packages booked is heavy enough. The record is the one the Wanderlane Traveller Club ledger keeps, and the concession is a rate standing against an instalment call on one of Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products.

**More than twice the frequent-traveller threshold.** Where the club ledger shows the traveller has booked more than twice the frequent-traveller threshold of packages in the last thirty-six months — the threshold being 3 packages and the multiple being 2, so more than 6 packages — the loyalty concession rate on the instalment call is the desk's loyalty concession in full, being 2 per cent.

**More than the threshold, but no more than twice it.** Where the club ledger shows the traveller has booked more than the frequent-traveller threshold of packages in the last thirty-six months but no more than twice that threshold — more than 3 and no more than 6 — the loyalty concession rate on the instalment call is one half of the desk's loyalty concession, being 1 per cent.

**In every other case** the loyalty concession rate on the instalment call is nothing.

## Where the record is read

The packages booked are the qualifying points entries the Wanderlane Traveller Club ledger records against the traveller from a package booking, counted over the last thirty-six months.

## Both sides of each boundary

| Packages the club ledger shows booked in the last thirty-six months | The loyalty concession rate |
| --- | --- |
| 7 or more | 2 per cent |
| 4, 5 or 6 | 1 per cent |
| 3 or fewer | nothing |

A traveller at exactly 6 packages is not more than twice the threshold, so the rate is 1 per cent; at 7 packages the rate is 2 per cent. A traveller at exactly 3 packages is not more than the threshold, so the rate is nothing; at 4 packages it is 1 per cent.
